feature_counts_are: sum of per-tile feature instances across zooms and tiles; repeated features are included and counts are not unique-object totals

building_component_registry.note: Do not collapse components by spatially matched OSM ID alone; components and conflicting render heights require further identity/LOD review.

canonical_schema_policy.height_m: explicit OSM height when present, otherwise OpenFreeMap render height
canonical_schema_policy.name: official_name then building_name; candidate-only names remain separate/not promoted

next_data_recovery: Decode the committed PBF tiles with the matching OpenMapTiles schema and export one file per thematic layer only after validation; do not claim the per-layer GeoJSONL catalog is complete based on its current empty files.
